text:
## Training & Exercises  
**Annual Training:**
- Incident response procedures (all IT staff)
- Forensic investigation (security team)
- Breach notification (compliance team)  
**Annual Tabletop Exercise:**
- Simulated incident scenario
- Response team activation
- Decision-making under pressure
- Communication practice

raw_entities.name: Incident Response Procedures Training
raw_entities.description: Annual mandatory training for all IT staff covering incident response procedures. This foundational training ensures staff can identify, report, and respond to operational incidents according to established protocols.

raw_entities.name: Forensic Investigation Training
raw_entities.description: Annual specialized training for the security team in forensic investigation techniques. This training prepares the security team to conduct detailed post-incident analysis and evidence collection.

raw_entities.name: Breach Notification Training
raw_entities.description: Annual mandatory training for the compliance team covering breach notification procedures and regulatory requirements. This training ensures the compliance team can execute timely and accurate notifications to regulators and affected customers.

raw_entities.name: Annual Tabletop Exercise
raw_entities.description: Annual simulated incident scenario exercise designed to test response team activation, decision-making under pressure, and communication protocols. This exercise validates the effectiveness of incident response procedures and identifies gaps in team readiness.
